name: PHD
description: PHD is a passage-level hallucination detection benchmark constructed with ChatGPT-generated data and human annotations. It focuses on detecting factual errors in passages rather than sentences, enabling evaluation of zero-resource hallucination detection methods.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark for passage-level hallucination detection that is cited in work on factuality and zero-resource hallucination detection.
notes: Focuses on passage-level hallucination detection with zero-resource methods; data generated by ChatGPT and human annotated.
